next.pattern: Regular meetings on the first and third Tuesday of each month at 9:30 a.m. (the rules say first and third Tuesday and Thursday, but the posted calendar uses Tuesdays, with a carry-over day the next morning if needed). Zoning and master-plan (CDMP) meetings about once a month on a Thursday at 9:30 a.m. Committees meet the second week of the month. All in the Commission Chambers, 2nd floor, Stephen P. Clark Center, 111 NW 1st Street, Miami 33128. Meetings end no later than 6:30 p.m.

levers.how: Speak on any public hearing item: register at the Agenda Coordination table in the chamber lobby (first floor) at least 15 minutes before the item is called; you are escorted to the chambers. State your name, address and whom you represent.
levers.rules: Up to 5 minutes per speaker on a public hearing item (Rule 6.04). Public hearings are scheduled for 9:30 a.m. You may also waive your time 'in support' or 'in opposition'.
levers.deadline: Register at the meeting, at least 15 minutes before the item is discussed

levers.how: Speak on any other agenda item (not a public hearing) during the 'reasonable opportunity to be heard' period under Rule 6.06, which comes near the start of the meeting before the agenda is set. Register with a speaker card the morning of the meeting.
levers.rules: 2 minutes per speaker, 10 minutes total per side; if more than five people sign up on one side they pick a representative who gets 4 minutes. No one may speak more than 5 minutes total on one agenda. Registration closes 30 minutes after the noticed start time.
levers.deadline: Register by 10:00 a.m. for a 9:30 a.m. meeting

levers.how: Citizens' presentation: ask your commissioner or the Mayor to place you on the regular meeting agenda to speak on any matter in the Commission's power. Only a commissioner or the Mayor can place you.
levers.rules: 5 minutes maximum (agenda item 1E). The Commission cannot act on it unless two thirds of members present agree it needs immediate action.
levers.deadline: Request to a commissioner by noon on the Monday of the week before the meeting week

levers.how: Budget hearings: come to the Commission Chambers at 5:01 p.m. on the two September hearing dates and register to speak on the first floor.
levers.rules: Register on the first floor; speakers are escorted to the chambers. Accommodation requests to agendco@miamidade.gov or 305-375-2035 in advance.

levers.how: No formal written-comment channel is posted in the rules. Write to your district commissioner (DistrictN@miamidade.gov) and the Chair; for zoning items, email presentation materials to the Development Services Division before the hearing with the Z-number.
levers.rules: Zoning materials: PowerPoint, 100 MB max, become public record and are shown only while you speak. Emails to commissioners are public records.

levers.how: Find your district on the Commission home page (13 district pages) or the Services Near You map, then email the district office. Each office also has a Stephen P. Clark Center suite and phone.
levers.rules: Email pattern DistrictN@miamidade.gov (no leading zero), for example District1@miamidade.gov, 305-375-5694.

levers.how: Zoning: Community Zoning Appeals Boards (CZABs) hold evening hearings by area (for example CZAB 2 met Sept 22, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at Highland Oaks Park). Anyone may speak. Zone changes, certain use variances and administrative-decision appeals decided by a CZAB can be appealed to the County Commission.
levers.rules: Appeal to the Commission within 14 days after the CZAB result is posted on the appeals log; fee $855 ($923.40 with surcharge); file in person at the Public Hearing Section, Stephen P. Clark Center 11th floor, by 4:30 p.m.; applicant, aggrieved party of record, affected city, or neighborhood association may appeal. Questions 305-375-2640.
levers.deadline: 14 days after the CZAB decision is posted
